_note: The exam of the lane's own sentences (decision 23; docs/AUTOMATION.md): every sentence the system wrote that the editor has read against the words it rests on, with the editor's verdict by the blind checkers' standard (good: the sentence says only what those words say; not good: it says something they do not carry, however small: a word of how often or how sure, a cause where the source reports, a hedge left out, a thing from elsewhere). Leaving something out is not counted as wrong. A checker of our own sits this exam beside the quiz cards' exam (data/auto/exam/cards.json), because this is the lane's real task. It grows with every batch the editor reads (scripts/editor/label_auto.py). The words a sentence rests on are the quotes the record keeps (the lane itself also sees the passage around them); 'passages' gives each quote with its source's name and its place, as the lane's own second reader sees them: a sentence may say 'Health Canada says' or 'a 2024 review' only because its source is named there.
